display_long_description:
Jump into a lively VR world where you are the fox. Sprint, climb, leap, and launch yourself through colorful environments using fast, physics-based movement that feels smooth, chaotic, and insanely fun. Every session turns into a new adventure, whether you’re exploring solo or hanging out with friends.

Fox Cavers is all about freedom and fun. Run around huge maps, discover hidden areas, and take on quests that keep the world exciting and give you something new to do every time you play. Team up with other foxes to complete challenges, or ignore the objectives entirely and just vibe, chat, and cause harmless chaos together.

This is a social-first VR experience where friendships are made naturally. Meet players from all over, joke around in lobbies, show off your movement skills, and create unforgettable moments just by playing. One minute you’re racing across the map, the next you’re laughing with friends after accidentally launching yourself off a cliff.

With multiple areas to explore, interactive spaces to hang out in, and quests that reward curiosity and teamwork, Fox Cavers keeps things fresh and replayable. Whether you want action, exploration, or just a place to chill and talk, there’s always something happening.

What you can expect:

Fast, physics-based VR movement that feels amazing

Play as a fox and explore fun, immersive worlds

Quests and challenges for solo or group play

Social lobbies made for chatting and hanging out

A growing community full of energy and
